correctness.rationale: Independent event-pair proof: if W is the off-diagonal jump-rate matrix and lambda=W1, the stationary ordered-pair event density at positive lag u is pi W exp(uQ) W1. Reversibility gives (pi W)_i=pi_i lambda_i. Subtracting the squared mean yields Var(C_T)=mu T+2 times the integral of (T-u)<f,exp(uQ)f>_pi from 0 to T for f=lambda-mu. The centered finite-chain inverse gives the asserted Green identity and long-time ratio. Every hop changes shore count. The three rates of departure are 2m,N-2,2n in order of 0,1,2 particles on the m shore, with hypergeometric equilibrium weights. Set the middle Poisson potential to zero; the two end potentials are [N plus/minus (m-n)(N-2)]/[N(N-1)]. The Dirichlet terms after division by the mean and multiplication by two have weights (n-1)/(N-2), (m-1)/(N-2) respectively, so an absent endpoint contributes zero. Expanding their squares gives N^2+(m-n)^2[(N-2)^2-2N] over N^2(N-1)^2. The sign change is exactly between 5 and 6. The energy can vanish only for constant jump intensity, which requires m=1,n=3 up to exchange; then each holding time is independently exponential of rate 2 and the full process is Poisson. At N=3 there is only K_1,2 with F=10/9. Central and star large-N claims follow directly. `python3 /workspace/reviews/replay_finite.py 2` independently solved exact grounded linear systems on all 19 unordered full configuration graphs for 3<=N<=9, with agreement. The frozen verifier was inspected, not run.
